en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a European city with a river in the foreground, a bridge crossing it, and dense historic buildings along the riverbank. Behind the city rises a steep hill topped by a large fortification complex. On the right side of the hill stands a prominent clock tower. Handwritten text at the bottom left reads "Graz, Schlossberg." Additional building signage is visible, including a sign reading "JOS SOGEL."
